title: Mitigating Black-Box Score-Based Query Attacks via Gradient Confusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.17382v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Score-based black-box adversarial attacks pose a serious threat to deployed machine learning systems by exploiting repeated model queries to craft adversarial examples, requiring neither access to model parameters nor architecture. Existing defenses predominantly rely on stochastic output perturbations, which fail to prevent determined attackers from recovering stable gradient estimates by increasing query budgets or averaging over randomness. In this work, we propose the Gradient Confusion Defense (GCD), a retraining-free, deterministic test-time wrapper that actively shapes the probability vector returned to querying adversaries. By solving a constrained optimization problem grounded in the model's Jacobian, GCD aligns the exposed logit-gradient with a target confusion direction that is maximally misaligned with the true adversarial loss gradient---increasing the query complexity of attacks without sacrificing predictive utility or t

translated_title: 通过梯度混淆缓解基于分数的黑盒查询攻击
translated_abstract: 基于分数的黑盒对抗攻击通过利用重复的模型查询来构造对抗样本，对已部署的机器学习系统构成严重威胁，且此类攻击既不需要访问模型参数，也不需要了解模型架构。现有防御方法主要依赖随机输出扰动，但这无法阻止意志坚定的攻击者通过增加查询预算或对随机性进行平均来恢复稳定的梯度估计。在本工作中，我们提出了梯度混淆防御，这是一种无需重新训练的、确定性的测试时包装器，能够主动塑造返回给查询攻击者的概率向量。通过求解一个基于模型雅可比矩阵的约束优化问题，GCD 将暴露给攻击者的 logit 梯度对齐到一个与真实对抗损失梯度最大程度错位的目标混淆方向上，从而在不牺牲预测效用或（原文在此处截断）的情况下增加攻击所需的查询复杂度。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需重新训练的确定性防御方法——梯度混淆防御（GCD），通过主动塑造输出概率向量，使攻击者获取的梯度与真实对抗梯度最大程度错位，从而在不牺牲模型预测精度的情况下大幅提升黑盒攻击的查询复杂度。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Gradient Confusion Defense (GCD), a retraining-free deterministic test-time wrapper that actively shapes the output probability vector so that exposed gradients are maximally misaligned with the true adversarial loss gradient, increasing the query complexity of black-box score-based attacks without sacrificing predictive utility.
